data.body:
Root-cause investigation (2026-11-09 PST). Verdict: the rejections come from OpenAI's side. rebar sends byte-identical requests that OpenAI accepted before, and in the same run it accepted the same bytes from the sibling test. No rebar code, prompt, model selection or request shape changed.

Evidence:
1. Request bytes are deterministic and unchanged. A loopback capture (local HTTP stand-in for the Responses endpoint, no real credential, every call answered with a 400 invalid_prompt body) recorded every first-turn Pass-1 request the discovery canary sends: 14 requests (6 single_turn chunks, 8 agentic). Their full-body sha256 values match exactly at c43d9336262 (green 2026-11-01 PST run 41398914029), 0f409b946e4 (failing scheduled run 42572022074) and 872e7f6c3fd (failing dispatch 42684304178), and they match again on a repeat capture. Model gpt-5.4, max_output_tokens 16000, include reasoning.encrypted_content, json_schema P1Output and the same tool list at all 3 heads.
2. The rejected request was the first, fixed request. The repo's own usage-log artifacts (external-usage-log-openai) record each failed call's shape. Dispatch 42684304178: both rejected plan-reviewer calls (19:35:56 and 19:36:02 UTC = 11:35:56 and 11:36:02 PST) have requests=0, tool_calls=0 and input_tokens=0, so OpenAI rejected the first request before any model response. Scheduled 42572022074: 1 rejection has requests=0 (06:19:11 UTC = 22:19:11 PST on 11-08). The other came after 2 completed turns and 9 search/list calls against the empty scratch repo (06:20:46 UTC). So 3 of 4 rejections hit fixed bytes. Tool output does not explain them.
3. The same bytes were accepted in the same run. test_workflow_live's plan-review test calls llm.review_plan on the same fixture plan, and only emit_sidecar differs, which does not touch the prompt. In dispatch 42684304178 it passed, so all of its first-turn requests (the same 14 byte-identical requests) were accepted minutes after 2 of them were rejected for the discovery test.
4. Nothing on rebar's side changed. The installed packages in the openai job match exactly between 11-01 and 11-09: 116 packages, including openai 2.53.0 and pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.9. .github/llm-providers/openai.toml is unchanged. The scratch repo is an empty-HEAD init, so agentic tool output is effectively fixed.
5. Base rate: 0 invalid_prompt in the openai arm's logs for the 9 scheduled/dispatch runs from 2026-09-07 to 2026-10-26 or in 41398914029 (37/37 plan-reviewer calls ok). Both 2026-11-09 runs: 2 of 37 rejected.
6. rebar's behaviour is correct: CHANGE_INPUT leads to LLMInputRejectedError, which degrades to INDETERMINATE, the designed fail-closed result.

Not established: whether OpenAI changed the classifier or the model behind the gpt-5.4 alias between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-09. The requests carry no snapshot id, and no OpenAI-side changelog was checked. Which 2 of the 6 single_turn chunks were rejected is not recorded, because the failure log carries no per-request fingerprint. It does not affect the conclusion, since all of them are fixed bytes that were accepted elsewhere.

No rebar change made: a retry would hide real rejections, and there is no rebar defect to fix. This AC cannot be met as written (the flag recurs, and there is no rebar-side trigger to fix). It needs an operator decision.
